name: fig_master_curve.png
caption: Error versus the grid-independent gap ratio delta_min/dx for all cases, with (solid) and without (dashed) the sub-lattice lubrication closure. Below delta_min/dx ~ 1.5 the error is resolution-controlled; above it the closure has no effect and the residual is a plateau.
